dataset: FirstMover Open Data Project - monthly NYC rental listings
month_definition: UTC calendar month of created_at_utc (listing first seen on market)

license_and_usage.site_statement: Every month, we collect publicly available rental listings and publish the raw data here for anyone to use. ... No copyrighted content like descriptions is reproduced. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by StreetEasy or Zillow Group.
license_and_usage.upstream_origin: Listings originate from StreetEasy (Zillow Group); FirstMover collects them.
our_usage_rules: Non-commercial academic use (COMPSCI 2880); cite the FirstMover Open Data Project.
Do not commit or redistribute the raw CSVs; keep them git-ignored.
Do not use the url / photo-id fields to crawl StreetEasy or Zillow.
